findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_races, get_race, save_race, remove_race, get_blocks · Private data: log_session · Public sink: update_session, update_note, add_block, update_block, update_profile · Destructive: update_session, remove_sessions, remove_race, save_trip_plan, delete_note, add_block, remove_block.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_races, get_race, save_race, remove_race, get_blocks · Private data: log_session · Public sink: update_session, update_note, add_block, update_block, update_profile · Destructive: update_session, remove_sessions, remove_race, save_trip_plan, delete_note, add_block, remove_block

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
